messages.author: bb4a45d0dd2b038e
messages.subject: normalize() also used by r-keras
parts:
Not sure if that is the correct place. However, I also use keras for R (in addition ty python keras): https://keras.rstudio.com/

What I noticed is (if keras is installed after Cardinal has been installed) that the function normalize() is used by keras.

Is there a general way to deal with such "double assignments"?

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: normalize() also used by r-keras
parts: Yes, you can use Cardinal::normalize() and keras::normalize() to refer to the appropriate functions.
